crossRefs.note: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for…
for when Jezebel cut off Yahweh’s prophets, Obadiah took one hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed…
Wasn’t it told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed Yahweh’s prophets, how I hid one hundred men of Yahweh’s prophets…

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.
translations.bsb: Then a company of fifty of the sons of the prophets went and stood at a distance, facing Elijah and Elisha as the two of them stood by the Jordan.
translations.kjv: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
translations.asv: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood over against them afar off: and they two stood by the Jordan.
